主要内容: The document titled '6-K' is a report filed by the Royal Bank of Canada with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on March 10, 2015. It is a Form 6-K filing, which is used by foreign private issuers to report information to the SEC. The filing includes two exhibits: a notice of the Annual and Special Meeting of Common Shareholders and Management Proxy Circular dated February 9, 2015, and a form of proxy mailed to common shareholders on March 10, 2015. The report is submitted under Form 40-F, indicating that the registrant is filing under this form. The document is signed by Karen E. McCarthy, who holds the title of Vice-President, Associate General Counsel & Secretary. This filing is part of the bank's regular reporting obligations to the SEC.
